_doc: All user-facing strings live here (bible §6.1). Linted against shared/banned-copy.json in CI.

ui.title: Pons Garden
ui.graphicsLost: The garden view was interrupted. Waiting for graphics to recover. The shared world is still running.
ui.tagline: Your land is forever. Your plants live and die by the raid.
ui.raidShielded: This garden is shielded right now.
ui.raidCapped: This gardener has been robbed enough this hour.
ui.raidMythic: Mythics can only be taken while the owner is home.
ui.defFenceDesc: Closes your gate. Thieves must break it: 3 hits, loud.
ui.defGnomeDesc: Patrols your lot and tags thieves.
ui.defSprinklerDesc: Slows anyone carrying a plant through your lot.
ui.defLockDesc: One plot immune for 24 h. Tap a plot after buying.
ui.sessionReplaced: This garden is open in another tab or device. Play here to take control again.
ui.identityRejected: This device's saved sign-in is no longer valid. Use the same wallet to recover a linked garden. Continuing as a guest creates a separate garden.
ui.signInStorageBlocked: This browser could not update its saved sign-in. Allow site storage and try again.
ui.orGuest: Already hold PONS? You can link a wallet in-game from the land button — never at the door.
ui.walletHint: No account, no email, no download. Garden With Eliza is a free browser game.
ui.adopted: Welcome back. Your garden is on this wallet.
ui.missionFull: You have enough on your plate. Finish one first.
ui.askTooFar: Come closer so we can talk.
ui.askCooldown: Give me a moment, then ask again.
ui.askEmpty: What would you like to ask?
ui.askTimeout: No reply arrived. Check your connection and try again.
ui.noWallet: No wallet found in this browser. Guests play the full game on a starter garden.
ui.connectHint: Your wallet is only asked to sign a free message. Never a transaction.
ui.linkOk: Land claimed. Your garden is a portrait of your wallet.
ui.linkFail: That signature did not match. Try again.
ui.walletCancelled: Wallet sign-in cancelled. Your garden is unchanged.
ui.walletChanged: Wallet account changed or disconnected. Please start sign-in again.
ui.landGuest: Guest garden. Connect a wallet to derive your land from its history.
ui.decorFlavor: Exotic flora from beyond the fence. It does nothing. It is lovely.
ui.sprintStart: Sprint! Touch the fountain and come back.
ui.sprintHint: Tap the track to start a timed lap.
ui.cantVisitCarrying: Drop that first, or carry it home through the signpost.
ui.noThieves: Nobody has robbed you lately. Enjoy it while it lasts.
ui.defScarecrowDesc: Looks exactly like a gnome to everyone else. Does nothing. Costs less.
ui.defMudDesc: Anyone who is not you walks slowly inside your lot.
ui.nickHint: Names show in the feed when it gets stolen.
ui.defBellDesc: You are told the moment anyone steps into your garden.
ui.plantPrompt: Tap an empty plot to plant
ui.emptySeeds: No seeds yet. Visit the Seed Conveyor.
ui.trainDesc: Train your legs. Move faster around the garden.
ui.welcome: Welcome to your garden. Buy a seed, plant it, watch it sprout.
ui.offlineBack: While you were away your plants made
ui.oddsNote: Your first conveyor includes one guaranteed common starter seed in its first slot. Other slots and later conveyors follow these odds. Your rarity floor raises the minimum tier offered. Regular top-tier odds are the same for everyone.
ui.guestLand: Guest garden, 4 plots. Connect a wallet later to see your land.
ui.controls: Move: arrows / WASD / tap. Interact: tap a plot or press E.
ui.landPrompt: Tap LAND to link a wallet: it shapes your garden, and holding 100,000 PonsGarden coin or 100 PONS puts you on the season prize board.

mutationFlavor.golden: It gleams. Everyone will want it.
mutationFlavor.holographic: It shimmers through every colour it can think of.
mutationFlavor.feral: It will not stay where you planted it.
mutationFlavor.backwards: It grows the other way. It seems fine with this.
mutationFlavor.screaming: Audible across the whole garden. A raid magnet.
